# Corpus fixtures

Real-world OpenAPI 3.x descriptors that the golden test in `test/golden_test.go` runs next to the targeted fixtures in `test/testdata/`.
They complement the targeted fixtures, which are YAML and written for this project, with JSON descriptors and descriptors written by others.
Each descriptor is copied verbatim, byte for byte, with no changes.
Its golden files `<name>_client.ts` and `<name>_warnings.txt` are generated by this project and are not part of the copied material.

The selection was collected in [grafana/openapi-to-k6](https://github.com/grafana/openapi-to-k6) on the branch `prep/k6-subcommand` (pull request 166, commit `42ed1d015b04f949d1e4e1600b618146104f94b7`), under `fixtures/`.

## OpenAPI Initiative examples

These files are the official OpenAPI example descriptors by the [OpenAPI Initiative](https://www.openapis.org/), from [OAI/learn.openapis.org](https://github.com/OAI/learn.openapis.org) at commit [`43756549c27cbf84107b190b82c65e0336f2f09f`](https://github.com/OAI/learn.openapis.org/tree/43756549c27cbf84107b190b82c65e0336f2f09f/examples).
They are licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); see the [upstream license](https://github.com/OAI/learn.openapis.org/blob/main/LICENSE).
They are not modified.

Only the OpenAPI 3.x examples are included, in their YAML form; the Swagger 2.0 examples are not supported by this project.

| File | Upstream path |
|---|---|
| `3.2-query-example.yaml` | `examples/v3.2/3.2-query-example.yaml` |
| `3.2-tags-example.yaml` | `examples/v3.2/3.2-tags-example.yaml` |
| `api-with-examples.yaml` | `examples/v3.0/api-with-examples.yaml` |
| `callback-example.yaml` | `examples/v3.0/callback-example.yaml` |
| `link-example.yaml` | `examples/v3.0/link-example.yaml` |
| `non-oauth-scopes.yaml` | `examples/v3.1/non-oauth-scopes.yaml` |
| `petstore-expanded.yaml` | `examples/v3.0/petstore-expanded.yaml` |
| `petstore.yaml` | `examples/v3.0/petstore.yaml` |
| `tictactoe.yaml` | `examples/v3.1/tictactoe.yaml` |
| `uspto.yaml` | `examples/v3.0/uspto.yaml` |
| `webhook-example.yaml` | `examples/v3.1/webhook-example.yaml` |

## openapi-to-k6 examples

These files are the descriptors of the examples of [grafana/openapi-to-k6](https://github.com/grafana/openapi-to-k6) at commit [`d2105fd0d3ffec8a0c5b9aa30bab1088eee56615`](https://github.com/grafana/openapi-to-k6/tree/d2105fd0d3ffec8a0c5b9aa30bab1088eee56615/examples).
They are licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/grafana/openapi-to-k6/blob/main/LICENSE.md), the license of this project.
Each was copied from `examples/<name>/schema.json` and renamed to `<name>.json`, with no other changes.

|---|---|
| `basic_schema.json` | `examples/basic_schema/schema.json` |
| `form_data_schema.json` | `examples/form_data_schema/schema.json` |
| `form_url_encoded_data_schema.json` | `examples/form_url_encoded_data_schema/schema.json` |
| `form_url_encoded_data_with_query_params_schema.json` | `examples/form_url_encoded_data_with_query_params_schema/schema.json` |
| `get_request_with_path_parameters_schema.json` | `examples/get_request_with_path_parameters_schema/schema.json` |
| `headers_schema.json` | `examples/headers_schema/schema.json` |
| `no_title_schema.json` | `examples/no_title_schema/schema.json` |
| `post_request_with_query_params.json` | `examples/post_request_with_query_params/schema.json` |
| `query_params_schema.json` | `examples/query_params_schema/schema.json` |
| `simple_post_request_schema.json` | `examples/simple_post_request_schema/schema.json` |
